rta mgrin bar chad kun sel ni: gtor ma med cing dkyil 'khor med: dmigs pa rang nyid rta mgrin ni: sku mdog dmar nag zhal gcig pa: dbu gtsug thor cog rta dbu gnyis: thor cog rtse nas rta dbus brgyan: dang po gnyis kyis ral gri dang: 'og ma'i phyag ni gnyis na ni: dbyug to dang ni zhags pa 'dzin: sku smad phur pa chu srin mal: rta dbus brgyan cing dbal gsum na: klu sbrul dug sbrul nag pos brgyan: oṃ ha ya grī wa hūm̐ phaṭa: kī la ya swā hā: 'di sgrub phan yon bsam mi khyab: bar chad thams cad zhi bar 'gyur: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: kha thaṃ gu hya: ྈྈྈ ྈ zhal gdams ni/ sku la dur khrod chas rnams kyis brgyan ba'o: ces pa sprul sku mi 'gyur rdo rje dgung lo bcu gnyis me sprel tha skar zla ba'i tshes bzhi'i tho rangs rta mgrin mngon rtogs dang mtshungs pa gcig gis dngos su gsungs nas yi ger bkod pa me la cung zad tshig shor bas/ slar yang mngon rtogs zur tsam/ yang bcos dgos byung ngo*// 'di'i dbang gzungs dbang nyid do// //
